housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 2,772.94 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Miami city centre. Zillow provides a Miami rental-listings portal. A deposit norm in months was not supported by the opened sources.

banking.summary: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit; requirements vary and should be confirmed with the bank.
required_docs: Proof of U.S. address showing the applicant's name and address
Possible opening deposit, subject to the bank's requirements

schools.summary: Miami-Dade County Public Schools lists International Baccalaureate and Cambridge International programs, and its Magnet Schools directory can be searched by international and advanced-studies themes.

legal_admin.summary: Miami has no separate city residence-registration step in the opened sources. Federally, most noncitizens, except A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors, must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report each change of address to USCIS within 10 days through a USCIS online account or by U.S. mail; stated exceptions apply.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a U.S. tax-processing number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply for an ITIN by completing Form W-7, generally attaching a federal tax return, and providing identity and foreign-status documents.

transport.summary: Miami-Dade Transit operates Metrobus and Metrorail with a USD 112.50 one-month pass. Florida may require holders of foreign-country licences to complete state licensing requirements. Eligible newcomers can apply for Marketplace health coverage online.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Florida reciprocates out-of-state U.S. licences, but holders of licences from other countries may need a four-hour Traffic Law and Substance Abuse Education course, written exam, or driving test; a vision test is required for all original issuances. Source: https://www.flhsmv.gov/driver-licenses-id-cards/general-information/frequently-asked-questions/
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply and enroll in Marketplace health coverage through HealthCare.gov; U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, and eligible lawfully present immigrants can obtain Marketplace coverage. Sources: https://www.healthcare.gov/apply-and-enroll/how-to-apply/ and https://www.healthcare.gov/immigrants/
